description: Binary assertions for /forge-fabrication static structure check

assertions.name: reuses_erp_skills

assertions.name: helix_handoff

assertions.name: one_block_per_turn

assertions.name: core_gates
assertions.check: WO release / acceptance / invoice are CORE non-delegable

assertions.name: cross_product_capacity

assertions.name: ceo_checkpoint_format

assertions.name: traceability_run_dir
